t: Brushless twin kit containing a combi drill and impact driver, with 2 x 5.0Ah batteries and charger. Combi drill features 2-speed metal-geared gearbox for durability, and variable speed control trigger to deliver up to 50Nm of hard torque. Impact driver controlled using the variable speed trigger, delivers up to 170Nm of hard torque. Both machines feature soft rubber grips, electronic speed brake, forward and reverse trigger, LED job light, and are manufactured with XPT technology to prevent dust and water ingress when used in harsh weather conditions.
